title: sideritis incana subsp. altiatlantica
intro: Sideritis incana subsp. altiatlantica, commonly known as the Atlantic Mountain tea, is a plant species belonging to the genus Sideritis, which includes several species of mountain tea. This plant is known for its traditional use in herbal medicine, where it is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Sideritis incana subsp. altiatlantica include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety and stress, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
